subject: Science
title: Year 7 Science: Half-term 6 (Reproduction, ecosystems, light and sound)

questions.question: Where does fertilisation usually happen in humans?
questions.explanation: The egg is usually fertilised in the oviduct (fallopian tube).

questions.question: Which part of a flower makes pollen?
questions.explanation: The anther (part of the stamen) makes pollen.

questions.question: Which of these is a change during puberty for both boys and girls?
questions.explanation: Pubic hair grows in both. The others are mainly in one sex.

questions.question: In the food chain grass → rabbit → fox, what is the rabbit?
questions.explanation: The rabbit eats the producer (grass), so it is the primary consumer.

questions.question: What do the arrows in a food chain show?
questions.explanation: Arrows point from the food to the feeder: the direction of energy transfer.

questions.question: If all the foxes died, what would most likely happen to the rabbits at first?
questions.explanation: With fewer predators, more rabbits survive, so their numbers rise (then grass falls).

questions.question: Why do polar bears have thick fur and a layer of fat?
options: To keep warm in the cold
To hide from prey in forests
questions.answer: To keep warm in the cold
questions.explanation: Both insulate the bear against freezing temperatures.

questions.question: What happens when light hits a mirror?
questions.explanation: Mirrors reflect light; the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.

questions.question: Why does a straw look bent in a glass of water?
options: Light refracts as it passes from water to air
questions.answer: Light refracts as it passes from water to air
questions.explanation: Light changes speed and direction (refracts) between water and air.

questions.question: A red apple is seen in white light. Why does it look red?
options: It reflects red light and absorbs other colours
questions.answer: It reflects red light and absorbs other colours
questions.explanation: Objects look the colour of the light they reflect.

questions.question: A sound has a higher pitch. What has changed?
questions.explanation: Pitch depends on frequency: more vibrations per second gives a higher pitch.

questions.question: A loud sound and a quiet sound have the same pitch. What is different?
questions.explanation: Loudness depends on amplitude (the size of the vibrations).
